data.narrative:
Evozyne is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised $144M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public companies in Biotech & Health, including later-stage peers Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B, Series C), Chai Discovery ($3.8B, Series C), and New Limit ($3.1B, Series C), as well as same-stage comparables like Eikon Therapeutics ($539M, Series B).

Two triangulation methods are applicable. The Stage-Progression method applies a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yielding $274M from the $144M raised baseline. The Peer-Median method uses the median valuation across four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables, implying $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be applied due to the absence of target revenue data; while the Biotech & Health sector median P/S stands at 6.2x across three tickers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L), private companies rarely disclose revenues.

These methods triangulate to a range of $233M (low, Stage-Progression floor) to $4.0B (high, peer 75th percentile), with a median implied value of $1.9B. The substantial dispersion reflects uncertainty around Evozyne's stage positioning within the peer set and the wide valuation spread in early-to-mid stage biotech. Revenue visibility and clinical/development-stage clarity are critical to narrowing this range.
